01About Smarctek

Connecting Industrial Requirements with Engineering Possibilities.

SMARCTEK LLC is a Connecticut-based business working where an industrial requirement meets the equipment that can answer it.

We start from what a plant needs to produce, where it will be built and how it has to run, then look at machinery and integrated processing configurations that fit. Equipment information comes from supplier documentation and is flagged wherever it still needs technical confirmation.

  • Equipment requirementsMatching machines to product, capacity and site.
  • Agricultural processing opportunitiesLines for cassava, flour milling and related produce.
  • International sourcingCoordinating equipment enquiries across borders.

04Processing flow

From Cassava Input to Packaged Flour.

Select a stage to see what it involves and which equipment is referenced for it.

  1. Cassava input

    Product is received and moved into the cleaning unit by conveyors and elevators. Intake layout, storage and feeding are set in the project diagram.

    Equipment in the reference configuration (indicative)

    • Bucket Elevator
    • Flour Conveyor

  2. Cleaning & washing

    The reference proposal lists a complete cleaning and washing unit. Its machine list is not itemised there, so scope is defined with the project.

    Equipment list is defined with the project scope.

  3. Drying

    A complete drying unit is part of the reference line. Dryer type and capacity are not itemised in the proposal and are set per project.

    Equipment list is defined with the project scope.

  4. Grinding & milling

    The grinding unit combines breaking, roller milling and sifting, supported by pneumatic conveying, filtration and feeding equipment.

    Equipment in the reference configuration (indicative)

    • Industrial Breaker
    • Pneumatic Roller Mill
    • Quadro Plansifter
    • Super Sonic Filter
    • Pneumatic Fan

  5. Packaging

    Finished flour is weighed and bagged in 25–50 kg units. The single-station machine is listed as an alternative item in the reference proposal.

    Equipment in the reference configuration (indicative)

    • Flour Packaging Machine
    • PLC Control Panels

06Engineering and integration

Beyond Equipment. Towards Integrated Solutions.

The reference proposal covers more than machines: piping, control, installation and the drawings that tie them together.

  1. 01
    Equipment configuration

    Selecting and sizing machines for the product and throughput.

  2. 02
    Processing line design

    A layout study that places machines and sets the capacity and efficiency target.

  3. 03
    Material flow planning

    Product routes between stages, with flow and air piping sized to each duty.

  4. 04
    Flow and air piping

    Connection pipes in different diameters, with clips, elbows and inspection pipes.

  5. 05
    PLC wiring and control

    One panel for all machines, channelled wiring, alarms and motor protection.

  6. 06
    Equipment installation requirements

    Positioning, fixing to the ground and connecting flow and air pipes.

  7. 07
    Technical project coordination

    Keeping drawings, equipment data and site requirements aligned.

The extent of Smarctek's involvement in design, supply or installation is agreed for each project.
